html:
SMTO-SKL-0042 — This Drive item can't be downloaded in that form

GUID: e0f10e78-e3e3-564b-8de0-1cee1a65baf3
Slug: google-drive-export-unsupported
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: google-drive

What happened

  • Google Docs, Sheets and Slides can't be downloaded as they are; they have to be saved as another file type. Folders and shortcuts can't be downloaded at all. Nothing was saved.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to export a Google Doc as PDF, Word or text; a Sheet as PDF, Excel or CSV (CSV saves only the first tab); or Slides as PDF, PowerPoint or text. These are the only formats SMTO can turn each Google file type into.
  2. If you picked a shortcut, ask SMTO to show where the shortcut points, then download that original file. SMTO doesn't follow shortcuts on its own, so it needs the real file.
  3. If you picked a folder, ask SMTO to list the folder's files and download the ones you want one at a time. A folder isn't a file, so it can't be downloaded as one.

What success looks like

  • SMTO shows a saved file in the conversation in the format you asked for.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Google Forms, Drawings and other Google item types can't be saved this way, so don't keep asking SMTO to download them.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Drive read targets an unsupported transfer: an export to a MIME type not offered for this Google file type, or a direct download of a native Google object (Doc, Sheet, Slides, folder, shortcut and similar).

What this means

  • Export requests an unsupported MIME conversion, or download targets a native Google object such as a document, folder or shortcut. This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Export requests an unsupported MIME conversion, or download targets a native Google object such as a document, folder or shortcut.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect mimeType and supported export targets; shortcuts are not implicitly followed.

How to fix it

  • DriveService._read raises export_unsupported when EXPORTS has no entry for the file's mimeType and requested mime_type, or when download targets an application/vnd.google-apps.* item. Use google_drive.export for Docs (PDF, plain text, .docx), Sheets (PDF, CSV, .xlsx) or Slides (PDF, plain text, .pptx); folders and shortcuts are not downloadable, so resolve a shortcut's target explicitly first.
  • Use export for Google Docs, Sheets or Slides with a supported target MIME type. Folders and shortcuts cannot be downloaded; explicitly inspect a shortcut target first.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use export for Google Docs, Sheets or Slides with a supported target MIME type. Folders and shortcuts cannot be downloaded; explicitly inspect a shortcut target first.

How to verify the fix

  • A supported export or explicitly chosen eligible file supplies the intended content.

What not to do

  • Do not expose credentials, content or resumable URLs.
  • Do not blindly repeat uncertain writes.

Technical notes

  • This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
